# Accessibility

BookWorm's client applications target the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.1 Level AA.

👉 **[Accessibility & Inclusive UX](https://foxminchan.github.io/BookWorm/docs/custom/frontend/008-accessibility-principles)** — WCAG 2.1 Level AA target, four-layer accessibility defense, streaming AI announcements, supported environments, and barrier reporting.

👉 **[Design System & UI Governance](https://foxminchan.github.io/BookWorm/docs/custom/frontend/005-accessibility)** — Shared accessible primitives, contrast tokens, responsive standards, and localization readiness.

To report an accessibility barrier, open an [Accessibility Issue](https://github.com/foxminchan/BookWorm/issues/new?template=accessibility.yml).
